scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The evaluation meeting
scenes.caption: Asha and Kabir bring their work together: a task brief, a data-quality log, a simple baseline, held-out results, a group comparison and a human review plan. The decision must follow that evidence rather than the polish of a demo.
scenes.dialogue: Should we use it, revise it or stop?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Evidence is incomplete
scenes.caption: The model slightly beats the baseline on the tiny pack, but dim examples perform poorly. The current proposal would label every sample automatically. A narrow overall improvement does not justify removing human review or claiming broad reliability.
scenes.dialogue: Our limits belong in the recommendation.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A defensible dossier
scenes.caption: An evaluation dossier states the intended use, data limits, comparator, test results, fairness concern and human intervention point. It records what should trigger revision or stopping, and discloses any AI help used in preparing the work.
scenes.dialogue: A go decision needs conditions, not just enthusiasm.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Make the recommendation
scenes.caption: The small test shows weak dim-condition performance and there is no human fallback yet. Choose the recommendation that fits the evidence before the prototype is used more widely.
scenes.dialogue: What needs to change before anyone relies on it?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: An unseen condition
scenes.caption: The festival moves to an evening courtyard that was never evaluated. The team pauses automatic use, keeps a manual route and proposes a separate collection and fresh test. New conditions require new evidence, not a recycled score.
scenes.dialogue: Our earlier score does not cover this new setting.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the lab
scenes.caption: Complete the dossier, defend a use or revise decision and handle the changed evening case. Record assistance honestly. Your teacher can ask for an individual explanation on fresh evidence, beyond the lab’s structured checks.
scenes.dialogue: Defend both the decision and its practical limits.
